65524.question_text: If 100 pieces of pests is attacking an hectare of cocoa farm and 25% suddenly died while 40% of the remnant is sent for medical examination. What is the number of pest remaining?

25% of 100 = 25 pests

40% of 75 = 30 pests
Total pest remaining = 100 - (25 + 30) = 100 - 55 = 45 pests

65528.subject: Agricultural Science
65528.question_text: Calculate the salvage value of a tractor with a depreciation value of ₦10,580.00 and initial cost of ₦50,000 after a year of use
65528.explanation:
Salvage value is the estimated book value of an asset after depreciation is calculated.
Salvage value + Depreciation value = Cost price
Salvage value + 10,580 = 50,000
∴ Salvage value = 50,000 - 10,580
⇒ ₦39,420
